subject: Error with fitting type 2 and 4 interaction model

messages.author: d286c929b0306a29
messages.subject: Error with fitting type 2 and 4 interaction model
parts:
Dear all,

I am fitting a spatiotemporal interaction model with covariates assuming negative binomial likelihood for 84 monthly count data from 136 blocks over 10 years and I have also fitted for 36 monthly count data from 136 blocks over 10 years. The INLA all shows the following error:

Error in if (nrep > 1 || ngroup > 1) { :
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

 *** inla.core.safe:  inla.program has crashed: rerun to get better initial values. try=1/1
Error in if (nrep > 1 || ngroup > 1) { :
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
Error in inla.core.safe(formula = formula, family = family, contrasts = contrasts,  :
  *** Failed to get good enough initial values. Maybe it is due to something else.


Mycode:


formula.intI<- Freq ~ 1 +
  f(sort,model="bym",graph=LDN.adj)+
  f(time,model="rw2")+f(time1,model="iid") +
  f(ID.area.int,model="iid", group=ID.time.int,
    control.group=list(model="rw2"))

model.ST15 <- inla(formula.intI, family = "nbinomial", data = yeardata, offset = log(pop),
                   control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE),
                   control.compute=list(dic=TRUE,cpo=TRUE))
                   )
summary(model.ST15)


I've tried a lot but haven't solved this problem, I hope you can provide me with help thanks.

Thanks and regards,
Yuki

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Error with fitting type 2 and 4 interaction model
parts:
I would check this part, and the values of 'ID.time.int'. recall these
need to go from 1, 2..., ngroup, and if not 'ngroup' is max(ID.time.int)
you need to give that argument spesifically.
